description: This file defines the configuration class for the Corporate Branding plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It implements plugin initialization by registering the ThemeService within a dependency injection container.

classes.name: CorporateBrandingPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the Corporate Branding plugin that sets up the ThemeService during plugin initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by registering the ThemeService in the container.
